items.question: What specific structural enclosure defines the hṛllekhā seed-syllable in this mantra form?
premises: The hṛllekhā seed-syllable is joined with six long vowels.
The hṛllekhā seed-syllable is enclosed by praṇava.
The particle eva emphasizes this exact enclosure.
items.inference: The hṛllekhā mantra is constituted as hṛllekhā endowed with six long vowels and enclosed by praṇava.
uncertainties: The precise identity and sequence of the six long vowels are not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: The hṛllekhā seed-syllable, joined with six long vowels, is indeed enclosed by the praṇava.
